resources.string: No WiFi yet. Connect the headunit to your phone\'s hotspot.
Open KlikBeam on your Android phone, pick this headunit, then enter pairing code %1$s. How to connect is in Settings › Launcher › KLIKBEAM.

Mirror your phone screen to the headunit over WiFi. Install the KlikBeam app on your phone: Android from the Play Store (closed test, join via groups.google.com/g/klikbeam-testers); iPhone coming soon.

How to connect: join the headunit to your phone's hotspot, tap OPEN RECEIVER, then in KlikBeam pick this headunit and enter pairing code %1$s. If the headunit does not show up, type the address: %2$s.

Note: mirroring works the phone hard (screen recording, video encoding, WiFi), so it can get hot and drain the battery quickly, especially in a car parked in the sun. Keep it charging, place it where the AC reaches it, and stop the broadcast if the phone feels hot.
Floating mode needs permission to show over other apps. Turn on USB debugging (Android Settings › Developer options), then try again.
Phone mirror is on. Tap for full screen.
